description: This source file defines functions for handling database operations related to runs and attempts in a certification backend. It includes functions for creating, retrieving, listing, and updating runs and attempts, as well as managing associated assets and notifications. It also contains internal utilities for asset signing and status aggregation, along with lazy import handling for external storage services.

methods.name: AssetRef _augment_with_signed_url(ref: AssetRef)
methods.description: Enriches an AssetRef with a signed URL if storage configuration allows and the path is in recognized format.

methods.name: AssetRef _to_asset_ref(a: Asset)
methods.description: Converts an Asset object to an AssetRef and attempts to sign the URL if configured.

methods.name: AttemptStatus _to_attempt_status(a: Attempt)
methods.description: Transforms an Attempt object into an AttemptStatus, including asset references.

methods.name: str _aggregate_run_status_from_attempts(attempts: List[Attempt])
methods.description: Determines overall run status from a list of attempt statuses.

methods.name: RunStatus _to_run_status(r: Run)
methods.description: Converts a Run object into a RunStatus, including attempts and assets.
